description: This file defines a custom application error class for a FastAPI-based web application, including methods to convert errors to HTTP responses.

classes.name: AppError
classes.description: A custom exception class for application errors, encapsulating error message, code, HTTP status, and additional details, with a method to convert the error into a JSON HTTP response.

methods.name: __init__(self, message: str, code: str = "INTERNAL_ERROR", status_code: int = status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, details: Dict[str, Any] = None)
methods.description: Initializes an AppError instance with message, code, status code, and optional details.

methods.name: JSONResponse to_response(self)
methods.description: Converts the AppError instance into a FastAPI JSONResponse object suitable for returning as an HTTP response.
